briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3.5 intensify multi-agent race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 new models this month with o4 leading in agentic tasks. Funding hit $9.8B quarterly amid infrastructure buildout. Prompt injection attacks continue rising in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with enhanced multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4.1 and DeepSeek R2 closed gaps on coding benchmarks. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 weights while xAI scaled Colossus to 1M H100s.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reached 500k units shipped. Microsoft and Google announced new 200MW AI data centers in Texas and Nevada. TSMC reported record AI chip orders for Q3.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level defenses like dynamic dialects become mandatory for all frontier model deployments by 2028?
